public_body: Massachusetts Auto Damage Appraiser Licensing Board
overall: The AG found the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law by entering executive session under Purpose 1 or by letting the respondent and his counsel take part. Rules-compliance claims were outside its scope.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to follow its own complaint-procedure guidelines in handling his complaint against a licensee.
allegations.key_passage: Whether the Board violated its own rules is outside the scope of our review, which is limited to enforcement of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board improperly entered executive session to discuss his complaint against a licensed appraiser.
allegations.key_passage: Here, the Board properly entered into executive session under Purpose 1 to discuss Mr. Cloutier’s complaint against Mr. Horton

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged he was denied the chance to attend and be heard in executive session, while the respondent and his attorney were allowed to participate.
allegations.key_passage: but Mr. Cloutier, as the complainant, was not required to be afforded those same rights.
